hero.subtitle: An app in your association's image — payments, events, news and the modules you dream up. We build it, deploy it, and support it with you.
hero.mockupAlt: Preview of the ProximApp mobile app

sectionFeatures.title: Everything campus life needs
sectionFeatures.intro: From payments to events, news and votes — plus the custom modules you dream up.

payment.title: Get paid in one scan — no fees
payment.desc: Dues, events and shop: your members scan, and it's paid.

ticketing.title: Ticketing
ticketing.desc: A full ticketing module for your parties and events — coming soon.

custom.title: And the ones you want
custom.desc: Modular by design. Tell us your need.

personalization.title: An app 100% in your image
personalization.desc: Your name, your logo, your colors, your features. The app belongs to your association — not the other way around.

video.title: See the app in action
video.desc: Two minutes to see how ProximApp powers campus life every day.
video.placeholder: Drop the demo video (or a thumbnail)

oss.title: Built in the open, yours to run
oss.desc: ProximApp is a real, production open-source stack: a Flutter client and a modular Python API. Fork it, add a module, or deploy the whole thing for your school.

titan.name: Titan
titan.desc: The cross-platform client — one codebase for iOS, Android and Web. Shipped to the stores as MyECL, myemapp, and your school's own name.

hyperion.name: Hyperion
hyperion.desc: The API — a small vital core (auth, permissions, migrations) plus modules you compose. Add your own.

finalCta.desc: Design, deployment, hosting and support — guided end to end.
